comparison.objective: Screen a media/workpiece mixture, versus erecting and latching a folding produce crate.
comparison.physical_skill: Pouring and coordinated agitation versus lifting hinged walls and engaging sprung corner catches.
comparison.success_condition: Recovered media with no washer loss or spill versus all walls upright and all four corners latched.
comparison.reason: Crate erection tests articulated-panel latching rather than granular screening.
